about: Music pack 1 gives you access to further killer tracks from Chase and Status, Kove, Modestep and Nero to listen to as you race around the galaxy.
PS4: One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PSN is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
PS Vita: One-time fee for use of downloads on up to 3 activated compatible Portable Console systems.
See Health Warnings for important health information before using this product.
